_comment: Verified Omnibus deployments. 'omnibusAddress' is the canonical CREATE3 address derived from (CreateX, Constants.DEPLOYER, salt) — predicted by `make verify-omnibus` and locked in CI by Constants_predictOmnibus.test_predictOmnibus_matchesSdkAddressJson; 'chains' lists chain ids where it is VERIFIED-deployed. The address below is the wallet-route Omnibus (salt entropy QUIP:Omnibus:v1.0.0-alpha.2, two-argument constructor), confirmed on-chain on Base Sepolia (84532). Add further chain ids only after the deployment is confirmed on-chain for each. Base mainnet (8453) uses the quip WalletFactory proxy 0xdCD90563B912f82D2f23d5c7988B3Fec2da63471 and the ERC-7913 verifier 0xE6F2970bA30d59e8288b7007bA755828372457c3. KNOWN DIVERGENCE: 84532 was built under the default profile (compiler metadata embedded); deploys from here on use FOUNDRY_PROFILE=prod (metadata stripped). The ADDRESS is identical either way — CREATE3 ignores init code — but runtime bytecode will not be byte-identical across chains, and 84532 must not be re-verified under the prod profile.
